description: Capability set for the main Tap Studio window. The webview runs on the sidecar's http origin, so it is listed under `remote.urls` — without that, every command below is ACL-denied to it. The sidecar binds with Studio__Port=0 (a free port picked by the OS at launch), so the port cannot be pinned here and a loopback wildcard is the tightest origin expressible. Because that wildcard also matches any other process listening on loopback, keep this list to the commands the SPA genuinely invokes: the shell, deep-link, updater, and opener plugins are all driven from Rust (see src/lib.rs), where the ACL does not apply, so granting them here would only widen what injected script could reach.
